data.description: 迦勒底个人生活间，天花板模拟出绚烂而深邃的星云宇宙投影。跪在单人床沿，双手抱着白色盾形靠枕挡在胸前，淡粉紫短发掩映着泛红的脸颊，紫色眼眸闪烁着信任与依赖，静静等待着御主靠近。 她微微抬眸轻语——“前辈……今晚迦勒底的巡逻已经交接完毕了。如果可以的话……能再听我说一会儿话吗？”
data.promptProse: Kneeling quietly at the edge of her bed inside her Chaldea quarters after late-night simulation training, Mash wears a lilac sheer lace teddy bodysuit adorned with a tiny silver star pendant. Hugging a soft white cushion modestly near her chest with a warm, devoted blush, she looks straight toward the viewer beneath the simulated deep-blue and violet cosmic nebula glowing across the ceiling.
data.animaCaption: Kneeling at the edge of her Chaldea bunk in her lilac sheer lace teddy bodysuit with a white cushion hugged gently against her chest, Mash smiles warmly with flushed cheeks. Simulated deep-blue cosmic starlight from the ceiling bathes the quiet room.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a fitted lilac sheer lace teddy bodysuit accented with a small silver star pendant at the chest and criss-cross back straps, baring her shoulders and legs.
